Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: GitHub Social preview for swift-mechanics, 2:1 landscape.
Edit target: supplied smooth pearl-white robotic Swift bird with partial internal cutaways.
Primary request: Upgrade ONLY the exposed internals into a sophisticated futuristic energy-driven robot that appears powered by a compact fusion reactor. This is imaginative industrial-design artwork, not a scientific diagram.
Central core: Replace the conventional toothed gears, orange piston cylinders and exposed mechanical transmission with a beautifully integrated miniature toroidal fusion power core in the central body cutaway. A precisely contained thin blue-white plasma ring sits within nested graphite and titanium-gray annular confinement structures, closely packed segmented superconducting coil modules, polished ceramic insulators and engineered shielding. Show a three-dimensional annular chamber with crisp construction details and restrained soft cyan illumination inside its aperture. The core fits naturally inside the bird body and is supported by the structural frame. Maintain dense layered technical detail, but use clean compact modules and seamless advanced packaging rather than vintage machinery.
Energy distribution: From the core, route clean superconducting conduits and compact power modules toward the wing roots and into the lower wing cutaway. Replace visible hydraulic actuators and coarse linkage assemblies with sleek magnetic actuators, precision flexures, integrated ceramic housings, fine microchannels, segmented control modules and thin luminous cyan status traces. Small orange/copper connector accents may link the interior to Swift's orange identity. Internal systems feel purposefully connected and highly advanced.
Material and visual language: Pristine contemporary engineering CAD cutaway, fine titanium/graphite edge lines, pale ceramic modules, a contained blue-white energy center and extremely restrained local glow. High detail within exposed regions. Smooth continuous outer shell remains the dominant shape. No excessive bloom or scattered lights.
Invariants: Preserve the pearl-white exterior exactly, its orange leading-edge accents, small black-glass head insert, recognizable Swift bird silhouette, position and scale. Preserve the precise existing cutaway boundaries and opaque panels. Preserve the entire left title "swift-mechanics", subtitle "Engineering mechanics in Swift", title colors, orange divider, dark charcoal background and faint construction grid.
Constraints: No conventional big toothed gears, old piston engines, coarse hydraulic cylinders or busy loose wiring in the new internals. No reactor outside the bird, no external machine, no second logo, no humanoid, no new openings, no text changes or labels. Keep the background dark and unlit; no beams, flames, smoke, lens flares, magical effects or overwhelming neon. Opaque background.
